resource: Lifetime of a command intent (expires_at_source - issued_at_source)
allocation_impact: A wider window is classified CHAR_CMD_INTENT_INVALID; an intent at or past expiry is rejected CHAR_CMD_EXPIRED, which bounds every transient retry.
boundary_tests: expires equal to issued is invalid
notes: Contract sections 3, 5 and 12. Internal Game-to-Platform boundary; no client wire. A refused or failed exchange stores nothing and publishes nothing: the intent stays PENDING and is retried until it expires. The consumer is disabled unless [platform.character_commands] is configured. Registered by CHAR-CMD-CONSUMER-1.
